items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Okay. Do you know Earl Turbinton? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: I don’t know. I didn’t know him that well. He heard me play and liked the way I played. He came and asked me to play with him.
Okay. Do you know Earl Turbinton?
